title: G6 auto-calibrate on a coded/native session
symptom: After a preemptive restart of a coded G6, an automatic calibration was sent to the G6 when a BG reading was taken for a G5 on a second phone, potentially sabotaging the code session.
evidence_quote: the primary phone handling the G6 took the occasion to sabotage the code-session by sending the calibration it had picked up from the paired meter to the G6.
